camdrones.guide.scene.camera_drone.title: Flying a camera drone
camdrones.guide.scene.camera_drone.descr: Position hold, flight modes, gimbal, ATTI and obstacle stop
Arm and climb. Let go of the sticks and the camera drone brakes and holds its position and height, even in light wind.
N, C, S: the flight modes
Unlike an FPV quad, the sticks set the speed. N: GPS holds position and horizon. C: slow and smooth for footage. S: fast, needs space.
The 3-axis gimbal keeps the picture level while the frame tilts. Tilt the camera up and down with the keys below.
Under blocks or in caves there is no GPS fix. The drone switches to ATTI: it keeps its height but drifts with the wind – steer it yourself.
Obstacle sensors stop the drone in front of walls. Compact drones only look down, Tour and Cine look all around.
camdrones.guide.scene.camera_drone.callo: N: sticks released – GPS holds position and horizon
GPS, compass and barometer keep it in place
C: slow and smooth for footage
S: fast, leans further, no obstacle stop
The frame tilts, the picture stays level
ATTI: no GPS – drifts with the wind

camdrones.guide.scene.first_mission.desc: Pair the flight planner, set waypoints and fly a mission
camdrones.guide.scene.first_mission.step: Put the drone down. Sneak and right-click it with the flight planner in your hand – the tablet is now paired with this drone.
Right-click blocks with the flight planner: each click adds a waypoint above the block. Right-click into the air to open the editor.
“Send” in the editor stores the mission on the drone. Start it in the editor, with the Mission button in the service menu or the key.
The drone takes off and flies the waypoints, even when you are not in FPV. Pause stops it in the air, in FPV the sticks take over.
With the end “to start” or “land” the drone lands. Over a landing pad it centres itself and touches down in the middle.

camdrones.guide.scene.follow_poi.title: Follow me and point of interest
camdrones.guide.scene.follow_poi.descrip: The drone follows you or circles around a point
camdrones.guide.scene.follow_poi.step.fo: Switch on Follow me and walk: the drone follows at a fixed distance and keeps you in the picture. If you stop, it stops too.
camdrones.guide.scene.follow_poi.step.co: Following other players needs the world rule and their consent. They see who follows them and can end it with /camdrones follow stop.
camdrones.guide.scene.follow_poi.step.po: Set a point of interest, for example on a beacon. The drone circles it at a fixed radius and height, nose and camera to the centre.
camdrones.guide.scene.follow_poi.step.st: Pause ends Follow me and the circle at once: the drone stops and hovers until you fly on.
